auth.disabled: Sign-in is switched off on this instance, so there is nothing to show.
auth.unavailable: The application is not reachable right now. Try again in a moment.

reason.expired: The sign-in took too long or was started in another browser. Please start again.
reason.not_permitted: Your account has no access to this application. Ask an admin to add you to one of its groups.
reason.failed: The identity provider could not confirm your sign-in.

emergency.title: Emergency sign-in
emergency.explanation: Local admin account for when the identity provider is down. Only available from the local network; every attempt is logged.

error.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
error.disabled: Sign-in is switched off on this instance.
error.failed: Sign-in failed. Try again in a moment.
